activity.overview: Use place value and area models to multiply, and read multiplication as a comparison.

problems.prompt: Write 35 = 5 × 7 as a comparison sentence using the words "times as many."
Use an area model to find 6 × 43. Break 43 into 40 and 3.
Use an area model to find 4 × 326.
Use an area model with four parts to find 23 × 15.
Find 34 × 26 using an area model or partial products.
Explain how the four partial products in your model for 23 × 15 match the four parts of the rectangle.

activity.subject: mathematics
activity.title: Multiplying with Area Models
